diabetes.name: Pregnancies
diabetes.clinical_source: PIMA dataset documentation; biological female population only
diabetes.notes: Immutable: this is a historical fact the patient cannot alter on a form

diabetes.name: Glucose
diabetes.clinical_source: WHO 2006 Diabetes Diagnosis; ADA hypoglycaemia thresholds
diabetes.notes: Primary adversarial target. Underreporting glucose is the most direct evasion.

diabetes.name: BloodPressure
diabetes.notes: Diastolic BP. Less likely attack vector than Glucose.

diabetes.name: SkinThickness
diabetes.clinical_source: Durnin & Womersley 1974 body fat estimation norms
diabetes.notes: Moderate attack vector. Hard to self-report convincingly.

diabetes.name: Insulin
diabetes.clinical_source: ADA insulin reference ranges; Tietz Fundamentals of Clinical Chemistry
diabetes.notes: High variance in data. Adversary could plausibly underreport.

diabetes.name: BMI
diabetes.clinical_source: WHO BMI Classification 2000; clinical case literature
diabetes.notes: Second most likely attack vector after Glucose. Adversary underreports weight.

diabetes.name: DiabetesPedigreeFunction
diabetes.clinical_source: Smith et al. 1988 (original PIMA study); dataset documentation
diabetes.notes: Immutable: derived from verifiable family medical history

diabetes.name: Age
diabetes.clinical_source: PIMA dataset documentation; dataset age range 21–81

heart.name: Age
heart.clinical_source: Cleveland dataset documentation; verifiable from ID

heart.name: sex
heart.clinical_source: Cleveland dataset coding; binary biological sex
heart.notes: Immutable categorical. Critical: cannot be fractionally perturbed.

heart.name: cp
heart.notes: Categorical. Adversary could misrepresent symptom type.

heart.name: chol
heart.notes: Primary attack vector for heart disease evasion.

heart.name: fbs
heart.clinical_source: Cleveland dataset coding; ADA fasting glucose thresholds
heart.notes: Adversary could falsely report normal fasting sugar.

heart.name: restecg
heart.notes: Immutable: objective measurement from ECG machine.

heart.name: thalach
heart.clinical_source: ACSM Exercise Testing Guidelines; dataset range
heart.notes: Immutable: objectively measured during supervised exercise test.

heart.name: oldpeak
heart.clinical_source: Cleveland dataset documentation; ECG interpretation standards

heart.name: thal
heart.notes: Immutable: genetic condition confirmed by nuclear imaging.

stroke.name: gender
stroke.notes: Immutable categorical. Cannot be numerically perturbed.

stroke.name: hypertension
stroke.notes: Immutable: established diagnosis from medical records.

stroke.name: heart_disease
stroke.notes: Immutable: established diagnosis. Interesting edge case: imputed from heart model.

stroke.name: ever_married
stroke.notes: Mutable self-report. Low clinical impact — likely weak attack vector.

stroke.name: work_type
stroke.notes: Mutable. Adversary could misreport work type.

stroke.name: Residence_type
stroke.notes: Mutable self-report. Likely weak attack vector.

stroke.name: avg_glucose_level
stroke.clinical_source: WHO Diabetes Diagnosis; ADA hypoglycaemia thresholds
stroke.notes: Primary attack vector. Same feature as Glucose in diabetes model.

stroke.name: bmi
stroke.notes: Second most likely attack vector. Adversary underreports weight.

stroke.name: smoking_status
stroke.clinical_source: Dataset documentation; AHA stroke risk factors
stroke.notes: HIGH RISK attack vector. Smoker claiming never smoked is a realistic evasion.
